trust_decision.summary: Django's CsrfViewMiddleware only checks unsafe methods, so whether a state-changing attendance-request action is CSRF-protected depends on the view refusing GET; at the pinned commit approve/cancel views in attendance/views/requests.py change state on any method.

landing_point.why: The summary names the attendance approval endpoint; the URL approve-validate-attendance-request (attendance/urls.py:450-452) maps straight to approve_validate_attendance_request.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both security-relevant sites are sibling functions in attendance/views/requests.py:453 and :588; the middleware/horilla_meet hunks (fix.diff:5-65) are an unrelated thread-local cleanup, not another route to the sink.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: approve_overtime explicitly declares @require_http_methods(["GET", "POST"]) (attendance/views/views.py:1528), so a solver can argue GET on attendance approvals is an intentional, maintainer-sanctioned exception and that validate-this-attendance is a different feature (attendance validation, not attendance requests).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The rendered UI uses the horilla_theme templates first (filesystem loader on horilla_theme/templates before app dirs), and those still call approve/cancel via GET; also the read-only detail view validate_attendance_request and edit_validate_attendance's GET form render must keep working on GET. A fix that refuses GET on the whole request module (or on the detail/edit views) breaks legitimate pages; the published fix itself leaves the theme callers on GET.

O6_input_shapes: HTTP method only: GET (and any non-POST verb) refused with 405 via require_http_methods(["POST"]) (fix.diff:169, fix.diff:177)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: validate-this-attendance: manager validates (approves) an attendance record on GET; UI calls it via hx-get and htmx.ajax('GET')
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Attendance validation, not an attendance request; different view file and different URL name from the report.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: approve-overtime: manager approves attendance overtime; method decorator explicitly allows GET
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Maintainers explicitly wrote require_http_methods(["GET", "POST"]), which reads as a deliberate exception; plain-href callers rely on GET (attendance/templates/attendance/dashboard/overtime_table.html:64).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: revalidate-this-attendance: un-validates an attendance record on any method
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an employee-initiated revalidation request rather than a manager approval.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bulk_reject_attendance_request reads ids from request.POST only; a variant reading request.GET or request.POST|GET would reach the same reject sink without a token.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring views already read query strings for filters (attendance/views/requests.py:641-643); a maintainer adding link-based bulk actions would plausibly read GET.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bulk_approve_attendance_request with ids accepted from GET as well as POST, reaching the same approval sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same reason; the approve logic is already duplicated between single and bulk paths (attendance/views/requests.py:466-487 vs :695-716).

O9_family: CSRF via state change on safe HTTP method (CWE-352)

O10_build.project_tests: attendance/tests.py exists (22 test defs), covering holiday/minimum-hour logic only; no tests for request approve/cancel views.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add @require_POST to approve_validate_attendance_request only (the named endpoint), leaving cancel and the validate/overtime approval routes on GET.

out_of_scope_notes: attendance/views.py is a stale module shadowed by the attendance/views/ package (attendance/views/__init__.py; attendance/urls.py:33 imports from .views), so its duplicate validate/approve functions are unreachable.
